title: Pilibhit voter roll row: UP CEO orders statewide ECINET login shutdown
content: Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa has taken stringent action against voter registration irregularities. He ordered the deactivation of login IDs used by voter registration centre operators. Following an inquiry, an outsourced computer assistant was terminated for their alleged involvement. District election officers have been instructed to verify the deactivation of these IDs promptly. The CEO emphasized the importance of maintaining the integrity of electoral roll management.

title: Island nation’s treaty with Australia raises concerns over loss of cultural heritage
content: Tuvalu's recent treaty with Australia allows its citizens to migrate for work and study opportunities abroad. While migration offers new options, concerns exist regarding the preservation of cultural heritage. Traditional buildings and construction skills might be at risk as populations shift. Researchers are documenting Tuvalu's architectural history through photographs and digital models. Decisions on migration and land use should integrate considerations of cultural heritage and community identity.

title: Publisher with 25m Facebook followers loses key claim over Meta's 2020 shutdown
content: A Canadian online publisher suffered significant losses when Meta permanently removed its Facebook pages in 2020. The publisher, which had millions of followers, argued that this removal violated its business rights. Despite submitting numerous advertisements, many faced rejection for policy violations, which included misleading content. A court upheld Meta's decision, emphasizing its protection under Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act.

title: UK court rejects legal bid to release lynx after 1,300-year absence
content: A conservation group aimed to reintroduce Eurasian lynx to Northumberland's Kielder Forest for ecosystem restoration. After submitting proposals for release, Natural England raised legal concerns based on existing wildlife laws. The conservation organization contested the regulator's refusal, arguing the laws should not conflict. However, the High Court ruled that the Dangerous Wild Animals Act still applied post-release.

title: Patrick Mahomes and wife Brittany bring holiday joy to Kansas City families
content: In December 2023, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes rallied together for EarlyStart's Clothing Kits for Kids campaign, aimed at aiding Kansas City families with much-needed winter apparel. Their charity, 15 and the Mahomies, generously provided several clothing kits to those in need. A thankful mother applauded the couple's dedication to supporting children and schools throughout the festive season, highlighting the event's role in fostering community solidarity.

title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donate $1 million to feed 2.4 million New Yorkers
content: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to charities across the US, supporting food banks, children's hospitals, education and animal welfare. Their $1 million contribution to New York's City Harvest is expected to help provide food to more than 2.4 million residents this summer. Several nonprofit leaders expressed shock and gratitude after learning about the unexpected gifts, which arrived as many communities face growing financial and food insecurity.

title: 'Will deal with Modi, Shah': Rahul explains why CEC Gyanesh Kumar is his first target
content: Explaining why the INDIA bloc has upped its attack on the election chief, Rahul Gandhi accused him of acting as an instrument of the ruling establishment and warned that those allegedly involved in undermining democratic institutions would be held accountable. The leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha warned the CEC and other officials against assuming that constitutional immunity would shield them from accountability.

title: 'Musalmaan hone ki saza': Azam Khan arrested by ED minutes after he gets out of jail
content: Azam Khan was arrested by the Enforcement Directorate just after being released from Rampur jail. He had spent nearly 11 months in custody due to legal issues. His son, Abdullah Azam, was released simultaneously but was not taken into custody. The arrest relates to a 2019 case involving allegations of financial wrongdoing and land-grabbing activities. Khan responded emotionally, asserting that his arrest is due to his identity as a Muslim.

title: Strangled after drinks, body dumped in lake: Wife, 2 lovers kill husband in Telangana
content: A woman named Gummadi Savitha conspired with her lovers to murder her husband, Gummadi Kashiram. They lured him out under the pretense of drinking liquor on October 23, 2026. Once he was intoxicated, one lover strangled him while the other restrained him. Afterward, they disposed of his body in a lake to conceal the crime. The police have arrested all three individuals and have charged them accordingly.

title: India complete historic double at Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship
content: India defeated Sri Lanka 54-20 to win the inaugural men’s Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship 2026 in Ahmedabad. Aditya Shinde led the attack with 10 raid points, while Yogesh Dahiya impressed in defence. India completed a historic double after the women’s team also won gold earlier. The men finished unbeaten, securing eight victories throughout the tournament.

title: Zakir Naik gets schooled by Malala's father for defending Taliban on girls' education
content: Zakir Naik, booked under India's stringent UAPA for terror-linked activities, said: "Everything that comes in the media is not true. The spokesperson of the Taliban said the situation there (in Afghanistan) is not very safe for women." The fugitive preacher said a Talibani ambassador assured him lesser restrictions when "safety is secured".

title: WTC Standings: Australia slip after series defeat; where are India?
content: Australia slipped to third place in the World Test Championship standings after losing their Test series 2-1 to South Africa. The defeat also cost them the No.1 spot in the ICC Test rankings, with South Africa taking over. New Zealand lead the WTC table, while India sit fourth. Australia next face New Zealand at home in December.

title: Tear gas, water cannon, clashes: France hit by third weekend of protests
content: Nationwide protests in France attracted an estimated 320,000 participants voicing concerns over rising living costs and government policies. Fresh clashes erupted between police and protesters in Paris, leading to the use of tear gas. While many protests were peaceful, some demonstrators engaged in violent confrontations with security forces. Participants included a coalition of youth organisations seeking change regarding economic inequality and public services.

title: 8-month pregnant Bengal woman delivers stillborn after assault by 'BJP workers'
content: In Cooch Behar district, a woman named Priya Pal lost her baby after an assault on her husband. The alleged attack involved suspected BJP workers who targeted her husband, Debajit Barman, while he was returning home. After the incident, both Priya and Debajit were admitted to the hospital for treatment. Two suspects have been arrested, while a search is ongoing for additional accused individuals.

title: Oleshky evacuees reach Ukraine after taking a detour through Russia
content: The evacuation of Oleshky's residents marks a significant humanitarian effort as they navigated through Crimea, Russia, and Belarus during a temporary ceasefire. With the aid of buses, this complex journey, affirmed by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, reunited families after long separations. The perilous living conditions and food scarcity pushed these individuals to leave their homes, ultimately finding refuge in the Chernihiv region of Ukraine.

title: 'Secret meets on foreign soil': PM Modi says opposition conspiring to divide nation
content: Accusing opposition of ripping apart the dignity and boundaries of the Constitution, PM Modi said: "Social media is being weaponised to spread rumours and to malign India's image. The citizens of the country must handle this together. We have eliminated Naxalism in far-flung areas, but the threat of 'Dimagi Naxalism' has not yet been averted from the nation."

title: Binance replenishes 90% of stolen crypto, says it will absorb financial losses
content: In a commendable move, Binance has restored 90 percent of the cryptocurrency assets lost due to a recent security breach. The exchange has pledged to handle the financial repercussions internally, ensuring customers are unaffected. Withdrawals are set to resume on Sunday, November 1, as Binance reinforces its commitment to transparency regarding its reserves.

title: Ireland's Indian-origin pacer Moondra creates cricket history with 6/26 figures
content: Ireland pacer Jai Moondra made history against Namibia in the fourth ODI, taking six wickets for just 26 runs in 10 overs. His performance set a new record for Ireland’s best bowling figures in international cricket, surpassing Josh Little’s 6/36. Ireland won the match by 130 runs to level the five-match series 2-2, with the decider scheduled for Sunday.

title: Jewish banker's heirs sue Sotheby's over £1.2m 'Nazi-looted' painting
content: A prized artwork by Camille Pissarro is embroiled in a contentious legal battle initiated by the heirs of Salomon Flavian. They assert that the piece was taken by the Nazis during WWII and argue that they were not adequately involved in a prior settlement. Sotheby’s counters, insisting the sale was aboveboard and legally sound. This dispute highlights ongoing hurdles in recovering Holocaust-era property and ensuring rightful family representation.

title: 'Keep Rahul mock PM for life': BJP's dig at INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of CEC

title: 13-year-old Goan girl turns backyard moringa into powder business
content: During her summer break, Grace de Souza, a talented teenager from Goa, tapped into her entrepreneurial spirit by producing moringa powder from the leaves of her family's two moringa trees. Her efforts have proven fruitful, with earnings nearing Rs 3,000 from selling 20 packets. Inspired by this success, Grace plans to sustain her small business even when school resumes, embracing the lessons of hard work and responsibility.

Designed in 1965 by architects Ainsworth, Angel & McClellan, the house features redwood-lined interiors, travertine floors and expansive glass walls . landscape architect Kenneth S. Nakaba designed the surrounding gardens, which extend across almost half an acre .

title: From Mallikarjun Kharge's lawn, 250 opposition MPs 'impeach' CEC Gyanesh Kumar

title: November to be slightly warmer than usual, predicts IMD

Uttarakhand helicopter crash reiterates concerns raised by Parliamentary panel
content: another chopper crash revives concerns over aviation safety lapses flagged by a parliamentary panel . the panel has highlighted several worrying factors at play in the helicopter services being offered to pilgrims . a panel on transport, tourism and culture has ceded direct oversight of one of the pilots' helicopter services .

title: Government extends Nilekani-led exam reforms panel tenure till January
content: the prime minister's office is seeking consultations with chief ministers and chief secretaries before the panel finalises its recommendations . some stakeholders and experts have also suggested a hybrid format for NEET-UG 2027, allowing time to expand infrastructure for a complete shift to computer-based testing (CBT) in 2028 .

title: Quad flags economic coercion, announces $85 million to expand AI access
content: foreign ministers expressed grave concerns about economic coercion . they also announced plans to provide more than $ 85 million in technical and financial assistance to expand access to "trusted Super Intelligence SI" the ministers backed ongoing cooperation on critical mineral supply chain .

title: ‘Water ingress’ incident on Navy vessel, no casualties reported
content:
Water entered INS Kesari while it was berthed at Visakhapatnam’s Naval Dockyard, with the Navy reporting no casualties and dewatering efforts underway

NEW DELHI: The Indian Navy on Saturday confirmed an incident of “water ingress” (flooding) on one of its ships while the vessel was berthed at the Naval Dockyard in Visakhapatnam. The incident was reported on INS Kesari, a Shardul-class tank landing ship. The Navy, in an official statement, said that “no casualties have been reported”. Efforts to pump out the water are underway, it added. INS Kesari, which was commissioned on April 5, 2008, has a 5,650-tonne displacement. Deployed in May 2020 for Mission Sagar, INS Kesari had delivered Covid-19 relief material, medical assistance and food items to nations in the southern Indian Ocean, such as Maldives, Mauritius, Madagascar, Comoros and Seychelles.

End of Article

title: Three falcons died in neighbour row; $500k case may reach Supreme Court
content: three falcons died and eggs were damaged after building work near aviary . former reality television star was sued by falcon breeders Martin and Scott Nicholas . one of the dead birds was valued at £150,000 . the court of appeal overturned the finding of private nuisance .

title: Opposition into politics of obstruction, must see anti-India pattern: PM Modi
content: the pm said the next major priority is fully securing India’s borders . he attacked opposition for abandoning its constitutional duty and instead resorting to politics of 'obstruction' he urged citizens to re-evaluate social media to spread rumours and tarnish India's image .

title: 10L turnout target, 4,000 cops, 200 CCTV: Delhi braces for INDIA bloc's anti-CEC rally
content: the rally is being organised to protest against alleged electoral irregularities . opposition parties expect a turnout of up to 10 lakh people and police deploy more than 4,000 personnel to manage security and crowds . the mobilisation comes amid the Opposition's allegations of 'vote chori' and large-scale voter deletions during the special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls .

title: 3 Kuki-Zos killed in Manipur gunfight with Nagas; mass rally halts Imphal
content: three Kuki-Zo persons killed in gunfight with Naga groups in manipur . thousands rally in Imphal against alleged militant activities . the killings were reported near Tajeikaiphun village in the Rongmei Naga-majority hill district .

title: As Trump veers off ‘coarse’ at rallies, GOP wonders if he can still deliver wins
content: president Donald Trump has spent an extraordinary amount of campaign time discussing the physique of other public figures . he is now approaching it with the enthusiasm of a man who has just been informed that his prison sentence has been extended . "my voice is operating at about 49.2%," he grumbles at a rally in Florida on friday .

title: Revolt in NC: 25 MLAs seek ministers’ ouster, J&K CM Omar Abdullah aide
content: around 25 legislators have sought a cabinet overhaul and the removal of Omar Abdullah’s political adviser . the resolution sought replacement of all eight cabinet ministers within 15 days . around 18 MLAs attended in person and seven joined online, a legislator said .
